micro_interview.question: You develop a quantitative signal that looks strong in-sample but weakens sharply out-of-sample. Walk me through how you would diagnose whether the issue is overfitting, data leakage, regime change or simply noise.
micro_interview.demonstrate: Hypothesis-driven debugging, statistical discipline, validation design, precise communication and willingness to reject a result that does not survive testing.
micro_interview.practice: Answer in 3 minutes using: symptom → four hypotheses → one diagnostic test per hypothesis → decision rule. Keep it conceptual first; only then mention code or metrics.
